reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Removes the trap, but changes how the calendar opens
summary: The calendar no longer opens on focus; it opens on click, Enter or Space. With nothing shown on focus, Tab moves on normally.
caveats: This changes the component's opening behaviour, which the frozen task does not cover.
Space in the date field now opens the calendar instead of typing a space.

The underlying fault is that vanilla-calendar-pro treats the calendar as shown when it is not rendered; a maintainer would more likely fix that state than stop opening on focus. Not suitable to propose upstream as it is; the reproduction is the useful part to report.
